1. Select Gaming as the product type on the Microsoft Hardware website.
2. Choose Xbox 360 Wireless Controller for Windows as the product.
3. Select the version of Microsoft Windows you're using on your computer and choose your operating system language.
4. Click Download to download the software.
5. Once the download is complete, click Run to install the software.
6. To connect the controller to your Xbox 360, turn on the console and place the controller within 30 feet of the Xbox 360.
7. Insert batteries into the controller if necessary.
8. Hold the controller's silver Guide button until it powers on.
9. Press the Xbox 360's Connect button, located to the right of the memory unit slots.
10. Press the Connect button on your wireless controller.
